title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity GLM analyses dHCP"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
---

GLMs in preterm-born neonates (dHCP cohort): perinatal variables, SES and cognition at 18 months (Bayley-III). Heatmap panels for Figures 4, 5 and S4.

- Input: `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_CP_Prematurity_single_GLM_PTonly_<date>.csv`: Table S8 (results/perinatal_GLM_CP_dHCP.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_CP_early_SES_<date>.csv` (results/env_GLM_CP_dHCP.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_CP_18mo_cog_<date>.csv`: Table S16 (results/cognition_GLM_CP_dHCP.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/p_heat_dHCP.rds`, `p_heat_SES_dHCP.rds`, `p_heat_cog_dHCP.rds`: heatmap panels, combined in `manuscript_figures.qmd`

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(here)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Helper Functions

```{r}
theme_claustrum_heatmap <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                     margin = margin(t = 4)),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      plot.margin     = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
  r_claustrum_ac_temp_r = "Temporal Associative (R)",
  l_claustrum_c_pos_l   = "Posterior Cingulate (L)",
  r_claustrum_c_pos_r   = "Posterior Cingulate (R)",
  l_claustrum_c_ant_l   = "Anterior Cingulate (L)",
  r_claustrum_c_ant_r   = "Anterior Cingulate (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_aud_l  = "Primary Auditory (L)",
  r_claustrum_pc_aud_r  = "Primary Auditory (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_mot_l  = "Primary Motor (L)",
  r_claustrum_pc_mot_r  = "Primary Motor (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_sens_l = "Primary Somatosensory (L)",
  r_claustrum_pc_sens_r = "Primary Somatosensory (R)",

sig_levels <- c("p < .05 (uncorr.)", "pFDR < .05")
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat_dHCP <- read_delim(
  here("data", "dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv"),
  delim = ",",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = "."),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      group == "term" ~ "FT",
      group == "pre" ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
  )

dat_dHCP_PT <- dat_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "PT")
```

```{r}
# ROIs with FDR-significant group differences in CP
sig_roi_codes_dHCP <- c(
  "r_claustrum_ac_par_r",
  "l_claustrum_ac_par_l",
  "r_claustrum_ac_pfc_r",
  "l_claustrum_ac_pfc_l",
  "r_claustrum_ac_temp_r",
  "l_claustrum_pc_aud_l",
  "l_claustrum_pc_mot_l",
  "r_claustrum_pc_sens_r",
  "r_claustrum_pc_vis_r",
  "l_claustrum_pc_vis_l",
  "r_claustrum_c_pos_r",
  "l_claustrum_c_pos_l",
  "r_claustrum_sc_hip_r"
)

sig_roi_labels_dHCP <- unname(roi_labels[sig_roi_codes_dHCP])
```

# Analysis 1: Impact of degree of prematurity

### Setup

```{r}
cp_vars_dHCP <- grep("^l_|^r_", names(dat_dHCP_PT), value = TRUE)
prematurity_vars <- c("birth_age", "birth_weight")
covars <- c("scan_age", "sex")

stopifnot(all(c(prematurity_vars, covars) %in% names(dat_dHCP_PT)))

dat_dHCP_PT_num <- dat_dHCP_PT %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(cp_vars_dHCP, prematurity_vars)), ~ {
    if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
  }))
```

## GLM: CP \~ perinatal variable + age + sex (one predictor at a time, PT only)

```{r}
results_prematurity_dHCP <- purrr::map_dfr(prematurity_vars, function(pred) {
  purrr::map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, function(dv) {

    fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c(pred, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- dat_dHCP_PT_num[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 5) return(NULL)

    fit <- lm(fml, data = df)

    td <- tidy(fit)
    gl <- glance(fit)

    row <- td %>% filter(term == pred)
    if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)

    tibble(
      predictor     = pred,
      dv            = dv,
      estimate      = row$estimate,
      std.error     = row$std.error,
      ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value       = row$statistic,
      p.value       = row$p.value,
      r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
      adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,
      n             = nrow(df)
    )
  })
})

results_prematurity_dHCP <- results_prematurity_dHCP %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

results_prematurity_dHCP <- results_prematurity_dHCP %>%
  group_by(predictor) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_by_predictor = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

outfile_prem_dHCP <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_CP_Prematurity_single_GLM_PTonly_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(results_prematurity_dHCP, outfile_prem_dHCP)
message("Saved: ", outfile_prem_dHCP)
```

### Heatmap (Figure S4A)

```{r}
pred_order <- c("birth_weight","birth_age")
pred_labs  <- c(
  birth_weight  = "Birth weight\n(per 100 g)",
  birth_age   = "Gestational age\n(per week)"
)

heat_df <- results_prematurity_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    estimate_scaled  = if_else(predictor == "birth_weight", estimate * 100, estimate),
    std.error_scaled = if_else(predictor == "birth_weight", std.error * 100, std.error),
    predictor_label = {
      mapped <- pred_labs[predictor]
      mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- predictor[is.na(mapped)]
      unname(mapped)
    },
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate_scaled),

    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr_p = if ("p_adj_fdr_by_predictor" %in% names(.)) p_adj_fdr_by_predictor < 0.05 else FALSE,
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr_p ~ "pFDR < .05",
        sig_unc   ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE      ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = pred_labs[pred_order]),
    ROI = factor(ROI, levels = rev(sort(unique(ROI))))
  )

roi_order <- unname(roi_labels)
heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = factor(ROI, levels = rev(roi_order[roi_order %in% ROI]))
  )

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data   = subset(heat_df, !is.na(sig_type)),
    aes(shape = sig_type),
    size   = 2.2,
    stroke = 0.8,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Significance",
    values = c("p < .05 (uncorr.)" = 1,
               "pFDR < .05"         = 16),
    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(-log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-3, 3), midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(rois %in% sig_roi_labels_dHCP,
                                   paste0("★ ", rois), rois)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_claustrum_heatmap() +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_heat_dHCP <- p_heat
saveRDS(p_heat_dHCP, here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_dHCP.rds"))
```

# Analysis 2: Influence of SES

### Setup

```{r}
early_vars <- c("ses_score")

stopifnot(all(c(early_vars, covars) %in% names(dat_dHCP_PT)))

dat_dHCP_PT_num <- dat_dHCP_PT %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(cp_vars_dHCP, early_vars, prematurity_vars)), ~ {
    if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
  }))
```

## GLM: CP \~ SES + age + sex (PT only)

```{r}
results_SES_dHCP <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, function(dv) {

  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ ses_score +", paste(covars, collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- dat_dHCP_PT_num[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 5) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  td  <- tidy(fit)
  gl  <- glance(fit)

  row <- td %>% filter(term == "ses_score")
  if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)

  tibble(
    dv            = dv,
    predictor     = "ses_score",
    estimate      = row$estimate,
    std.error     = row$std.error,
    ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
    t_value       = row$statistic,
    p.value       = row$p.value,
    r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
    adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,
    n             = nrow(df)
  )
})

results_SES_dHCP <- results_SES_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_fdr)

outfile_single_num <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_CP_early_SES_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
write_csv2(results_SES_dHCP, outfile_single_num)
message("Saved: ", outfile_single_num)
```

### Heatmap (Figure 4A)

```{r}
labels_map <- c(ses_score = "SES score")

heat_df <- results_SES_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    predictor_label = labels_map[predictor],
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate),
    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr   = p_adj_fdr < 0.05,
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr ~ "pFDR < .05",
        sig_unc ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE    ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = "SES score"),
    ROI = factor(ROI, levels = rev(unname(roi_labels)))
  )

dummy_sig <- data.frame(
  predictor_label = factor("SES score",
                           levels = levels(heat_df$predictor_label)),
  ROI      = factor(levels(heat_df$ROI)[1],
                    levels = levels(heat_df$ROI)),
  sig_type = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels)
)

p_heat_SES_dHCP <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data   = subset(heat_df, !is.na(sig_type)),
    aes(shape = sig_type),
    size   = 2.3,
    stroke = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    na.rm  = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data        = dummy_sig,
    aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, shape = sig_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha       = 0,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Significance",
    values = c("p < .05 (uncorr.)" = 1,
               "pFDR < .05"         = 16),
    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(-log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-3, 3), midpoint = 0
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(
      rois %in% sig_roi_labels_dHCP,
      paste0("★ ", rois),
      rois
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_claustrum_heatmap() +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

saveRDS(p_heat_SES_dHCP, here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_SES_dHCP.rds"))
```

# Analysis 3: Influence of neonatal CP on cognition

### Setup

```{r}
cog_var <- "bsid_cog_composite"
stopifnot(cog_var %in% names(dat_dHCP_PT))
```

## GLM: Bayley-III cognition \~ CP + age + sex (PT only)

```{r}
results_CP_to_cog_dHCP <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, function(pred) {

  fml <- as.formula(paste(cog_var, "~", paste(c(pred, covars), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- dat_dHCP_PT_num[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 8) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  td  <- tidy(fit)
  gl  <- glance(fit)

  row <- td %>% filter(term == pred)
  if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)

  tibble(
    predictor     = pred,
    dv            = cog_var,
    estimate      = row$estimate,
    std.error     = row$std.error,
    ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
    t_value       = row$statistic,
    p.value       = row$p.value,
    r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
    adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,
    n             = nrow(df)
  )
})

results_CP_to_cog_dHCP <- results_CP_to_cog_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_fdr, p.value)

results_CP_to_cog_dHCP <- results_CP_to_cog_dHCP %>%
  group_by(predictor) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_by_predictor = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

outfile_dHCP_cog <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_CP_18mo_cog_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
write_csv2(results_CP_to_cog_dHCP, outfile_dHCP_cog)
message("Saved: ", outfile_dHCP_cog)
```

### Heatmap (Figure 5A)

```{r}
heat_df <- results_CP_to_cog_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = dplyr::recode(predictor, !!!roi_labels, .default = predictor),
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate),
    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr   = p_adj_fdr < 0.05,
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr ~ "pFDR < .05",
        sig_unc ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE    ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = factor(ROI, levels = rev(unname(roi_labels))),
    predictor_label = "Bayley III cognition\nat 18 months"
  )

p_heat_CP_to_cog <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +

    data   = subset(heat_df, !is.na(sig_type)),

    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(-log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-3, 3), midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(rois %in% sig_roi_labels_dHCP,

    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
```
